Mod.Name: Lost Wing
Mod.Description: Difficulty mod with a huge overhaul of the battle system. Including new materia, and items! Lost Wing is a FF7 Overhaul that completely modifies many aspects of the game. It is moderately difficult until the Huge Materia quests, then it becomes Extremely Difficult. Hacking/Cheating/Modding All Equipment and/or Materia is encouraged post-Diamond WEAPON.
